learning_outcomes.text: Identify where AI can support audit and assurance work and where it cannot
Use AI to assist risk assessment, sampling and analytical procedures responsibly
Apply AI to document review and evidence summarisation with human verification
Recognise bias, hallucination and data-confidentiality risks in audit contexts
Maintain audit evidence, documentation and professional scepticism when using AI

integrative_case: A senior auditor must decide how to use AI on an engagement: pick two tasks where AI adds value and one where it must not be relied on, design the human-review controls, protect client confidentiality, and document the AI use so the file withstands review.
